title: Session 4 final - script, slides and PowerPoint, ready to record Monday
summary:
All your Nov 13 answers applied: seven patterns (Own the Thinking back in the chain as talk track, its card on slide 4 says "One specific thing from the post, one from her own experience"); Part D shown from slide 5, not live; c13 not applied (phone size). Accepted changes 1-3, 5-10, 12, 14, 16-21 are in: Act II is now an almost-right comment under a VP of Operations' tough-quarter post; skip-these-posts rule (grief, layoffs, health) in the briefing; "a reply" is the win, the meeting a bonus; no profile visits; "Your number" labels; AI's draft / Carla's line labels; Greg's exact save line for Part B; the page link on the last slide; a printable one-line list of the seven on the page copy. LinkedIn line from Sunday's 4 PM check: "LinkedIn said it plainly this year: comments posted by automation tools aren't allowed. They get buried in the comments and can get your account restricted. Carla's routine never posts anything - she does." Reveal: "Carla's fictional. The routine is mine - I run it every weekday. The AI drafts; I rewrite and post every comment myself."
